body.name: Data encrypted at rest
body.description: Sensitive data is encrypted in storage.
body.detail: Encryption at rest is a property of the volumes this runs on, which the application cannot observe.
observations: Postgres and Neo4j both persist to host-managed volumes.
The application adds integrity (SHA-256 chaining), which is a different property from confidentiality and not a substitute for it.
Attest with the storage layer's encryption configuration.
